component.name: Binder
component.summary: PDF library with highlights, bookmarks, dog-ears and notes

description.p: Binder is a simple desktop library for your PDFs. Open a book, highlight passages in several colours, bookmark pages, fold a page's corner with a dog-ear, and leave sticky notes. All your notes are gathered on one page.
Your PDFs and notes are stored as plain files in the Binder folder in your home directory, independent of the app.

screenshot.caption: Reading a PDF with highlight, sticky note, bookmark and dog-ear tools
